readme:
# Framepack

Framepack serves HyperFrames programmatic commercial video ideation and composition.

中文：Framepack 服务的是面向 HyperFrames 程式化商业视频创意与编排。

The agent is the director. Framepack is the director's advisor, producer, arsenal manager, and HyperFrames quality gate.

It manages workflow blueprints, event-promo structures, STORYBOARD.md, .framepack/arsenal.json, reference mining, reusable template blueprints, trusted cache manifests, motion recipes, design references, and strict render-safety checks.

Quick path:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium founder summit event promo" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name summit
npx framepack arsenal recommend --idea "A premium founder summit event promo" --format 9:16 --type event-promo
npx framepack reference mine --project-dir ./out/summit --video ./reference.mp4
npx framepack workbench audit --phase preflight --project-dir ./out/summit
npx framepack build --project-dir ./out/summit
npx framepack preview --project-dir ./out/summit --open
```
